bullets: Huge military exercises are underway off and around Britain's coast, involving 13,000 personnel from 14 countries.

slides.title: Motivations Behind the Exercises

Other personnel mention competition between different nations and individual ships and subs as a significant motivator.

slides.speaker_notes: The motivations behind the Joint Warrior exercises are multifaceted. While the exercises are not a direct response to Russia's actions, they do reflect the alliance's commitment to collective defense and its ability to respond to emerging threats.

slides.title: Exercise Structure and Objectives
bullets: The exercises are divided into two parts: set training exercises and 'free play'.
Set training exercises involve vessels or groups completing specific jobs, while 'free play' involves teams with manipulated orders and motivations.
The exercises are designed to test the alliance's ability to work together and respond to emerging threats in a dynamic environment.
slides.speaker_notes: The Joint Warrior exercises are structured to test the alliance's ability to work together and respond to emerging threats.
